actions.body: Research suggests that autonomous agents can enhance their problem formulation capability by systematically addressing implementation constraints. Evidence indicates that iterative refinement processes are essential for closing the gap between conceptual problem spaces and practical execution. This requires shifting from static problem definitions to adaptive heuristic frameworks that allow the agent to reassess the value of its inquiry paths.
